location.title: How to find us
location.lead: Wrzeszcz, ul. Jana Kilińskiego 7E — in the former brewery in Kuźniczki.
location.carText: About 3 km from Gdańsk city centre. Entrance from ul. Kilińskiego.
location.transitText: SKM/PKM Gdańsk Wrzeszcz (10 min walk), trams and buses — Kilińskiego / Miszewskiego stop.
location.parkingText: Guest parking at the venue plus spaces in the paid parking zone.
